newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Taihan begins production at China plant.
newsitem.headline: Taihan begins production at China plant.

text.p: South Korea's Taihan Sugar Corp said on Friday its newly-constructed feed milling plant in China had begun production at full capacity.
The plant, Tianjin Rainbow Feed Co Ltd, has annual production capacity of 240,000 tonnes.

A Taihan spokesman said Taihan had a 70 percent stake in the plant. The remaining 30 percent was held by South Korean trading house Ssangyong Corp. Taihan and Ssangyong have invested a combined total of $10 million in the plant.
Taihan planned to build more plants and extend its annual production to 500,000 tonnes. It targetted annual turnover of $100 million by 2000.
